'''Bluefen''' is a marshy area located on northern [[Dustwallow Marsh]], in between [[Brackenwall Village]] and [[Blackhoof Village]]. It is overran with [[spider]]s, [[bird]]s, [[raptor]]s, [[crocolisk]]s, and [[Theramore Infiltrator]]s.
